latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of mfds-cli, a CLI for Korea Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) public APIs.
- Supports searching drug product permissions, consumer-friendly drug info, DUR contraindications, and drug recall/sale-stop alerts, all normalized to JSONL output.
- Four main subcommands: drug, drug-easy, dur, and recall, each wrapping a corresponding MFDS API endpoint.
- Includes detailed flag support, normalization options, and example usage scripts for pharmacy and healthcare workflows.
- Requires free MFDS_API_KEY registration at data.go.kr; data rate limits and licensing are documented.
